title: Journey Configuration
description: Schema for journey (dynamic tempo/visual evolution) configuration.

journey.description: Journey preset name - controls how tempo/speed/complexity evolve over time

journey_intensity.description: How dramatic the journey changes are (subtle=0.5x, moderate=1x, dramatic=1.5x)

journey_descriptions.steady: Constant tempo and visuals - traditional ambient
journey_descriptions.awakening: Gradual rise from stillness to energy - morning meditation
journey_descriptions.crescendo: Build to peak then release - emotional journey
journey_descriptions.waves: Long slow swells like ocean waves
